newsitem.title: USA: Record U.S. steel center daily shipments in March.
newsitem.headline: Record U.S. steel center daily shipments in March.

text.p: U.S. steel service centers shipped at a rate of over 117,000 tons per day in March, setting a record for the average daily shipping rate for one month, the Steel Service Center Institute reported.

"Yet there is reason to believe that volume may stay at this level or climb, as 40 percent of the Purchasing Managers' steel committee believe incoming orders will rise in the next three months," the SSCI said in a statement.
The overall shipping rate in March rose 10 percent from the same month last year. The first quarter's shipping rate grew 7.8 percent over the last quarter of 1996.

The ending inventory for March rose slightly from February's total of 7,034,027 tons to 7,068,047 tons. The number of months of shipments on hand dropped slightly to 2.9 months as a result of the higher shipping rate.
